bad_guidance.why: ABSTAIN with 'no UI vocabulary found': zero core and zero guardrail records for an in-scope UI task on an existing board screen; none of the 3 critical concepts delivered.

misses.what: Scope gate returned abstain ('no UI vocabulary found') for a sentence containing 'board', 'front desk', 'patient', 'waiting room'; activation ui_score=0. Everything downstream (concerns, concepts, core, guardrails) was empty as a consequence.

surfaces=flat-tonal UNKNOWN with evidence 'no shadow or border declarations found' while the codebase uses Tailwind border/border-neutral-200 on every card, column, header and rail (bordered-flat, not flat-tonal); radius UNKNOWN while 'rounded'/'rounded-sm' is used consistently; typography tabular_numerals=false while the code uses tabular-nums in 5 files.

product=ecommerce inferred from README alongside healthcare; problem_domain=performance-ux from the word 'wait' (this is an information-missing problem, not perceived performance); mode_evidence 'perceived-performance defect' is a misreading of 'how long each patient has been sitting'.

Validation VIOLATION 'audit: no accessibility constraints attached' is a self-contradiction: requirements.accessibility has all six flags true. The focus slot was marked 'new' with 'no repository evidence' although Button.svelte and +layout.svelte define focus-visible:ring-2 ring-primary-500.

regressions.query: The waiting room board: nothing tells the front desk how long each patient has been sitting there.
regressions.expect: scope.kind=in-scope (domain: status board / live operational display); mode polish or refactor on an existing screen; concepts env.glanceable_status, data.realtime_window, a11y.color_not_only delivered; problem_domain should not be performance-ux.

regressions.query: Nothing on the kanban board shows how long a card has been sitting in a column.
regressions.expect: in-scope; delivers env.glanceable_status, data.realtime_window, table.tabular_figures, perf.layout_shift; not abstain.

regressions.query: inspect_project on a Tailwind codebase using border border-neutral-200 and rounded on every surface
regressions.expect: surfaces=bordered-flat (KNOWN or INFERRED, not UNKNOWN); radius detected from rounded/rounded-sm; typography.tabular_numerals=true when tabular-nums is used.
